summary: Phase 147B froze a new companion contract, docs/contracts/AUTHORITY_EVALUATION_MODEL_CONTRACT.md (AEM-001 v1.0), closing the authority-evaluation gap (informally C-1) Phase 147A selected as Chapter 147's objective. Independently re-derived every requirement directly from IWC-001, IWPC-001 (Sec.4.1, Sec.18, Sec.29 item C-1, Sec.31), CHGR-001 (Sec.11 Authority Contract, Sec.20.5, CHGR-REQ-096/097/199, Phase 146K's PEC-REQ-115), TAMC-001/TAMPC-001, and GAC-001 Sec.9 primary text, confirming by direct source inspection that no eligible_authority field, Decision Template class, or evaluation mechanism exists anywhere in src/pcae today (Session.template_ref is a bare, unvalidated str). Defines a closed-form EligibleAuthorityDeclaration (a non-empty set of literal eligible claimed-identity strings, keyed immutably to template_ref plus template_version, deliberately not a role/scope/policy language); a deterministic, total, pure evaluation function producing exactly one immutable AuthorityEvaluationOutcome with a closed three-valued result (eligible/ineligible/indeterminate); and the rule by which an eligible outcome may populate CHGR-001's already-reserved authority_basis_claimed field via PEC-REQ-115's existing citation-only discipline, always preserving CHGR-REQ-199's absent-not-fabricated discipline wherever no declaration exists. Resolved the one open judgment call Phase 147A Sec.6.2 left to this phase -- whether an unfavorable evaluation ever blocks Confirmation or Publication -- in favor of disclosure-only, with explicit reasoning recorded at AEM-001 Sec.16: a gating rule would constitute an authority-evaluation policy, which IWPC-REQ-002/003 forbid this contract family from inventing, and would require PEC-001's Coordinator to make exactly the independent judgment of validity PEC-REQ-115 already forbids. Explicitly distinguished this contract's authority concept from two unrelated same-named concepts: TAMC-001/TAMPC-001's CLTR authority_epoch/authority_state lifecycle-transition model, and GAC-001 Sec.9's one-time, pilot-scoped governance-adoption decision -- neither is discharged, narrowed, or touched by this contract's existence. Disclosed, rather than silently omitted, that the Decision Template Authority Registry's storage and authoring mechanics are deferred to a future Implementation Planning phase, because unlike IWPC-001 Sec.13's SessionRepository, no pre-existing Decision Template artifact exists anywhere in this repository today for this phase to extend. Zero Blocking findings recorded in the Conflict and Findings Register (seven Non-Blocking Observations, each disclosed and either resolved by explicit reasoning or named as a deliberately deferred future extension). Verdict: CONTRACT FROZEN. Full detail in docs/PHASE_147B_AUTHORITY_EVALUATION_MODEL_CONTRACT_FREEZE.md.
